name: Warsong Scout Update
summary: At Splintertree Post, a Warsong scout records what the Horde needs to know about Ashenvale.

sections.title: Eyes in the Ancient Forest
sections.body: Warsong scouts watch the woods as the Horde seeks timber and supply routes through Ashenvale. From Splintertree Post, a fortified encampment, they track night elf sentinels and movements across the territory. Their observations reach Kadrak at the Barrens-Ashenvale border among routine orders. He uses them to judge troop readiness and coordinate supplies and travel through the contested woods.

faq.q: What is the Warsong Scout Update?
faq.answer: The Warsong Scout Update gathers a Warsong scout’s observations from Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale for commanders on the border.
Kadrak needs the update. The Horde officer watches the border between the northern Barrens and Ashenvale from a watchtower, and uses it to plan military maneuvers.

faq.q: Where is the Warsong Scout located?
faq.answer: The scout is stationed inside Splintertree Post, the Horde stronghold along the main road through eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why are these dispatches so important to the Horde?
faq.answer: Night elves fiercely defend Ashenvale. Scout reports warn Horde leaders of ambushes and troop movements, helping keep supply routes and logging camps secure.

angles.text: Warsong dispatches keep the Horde’s forward camps in Ashenvale in contact with supply bases in the Barrens as the Horde expands into the forest.
As an orc, you know the Warsong clan bears the brunt of the logging campaign in Ashenvale. Swift scouts help hold its forest outposts.
